description_expanded:
Rosemary Beach!

Steps to private beach access

Private balcony with scenic Gulf views

Stunning interiors and unique architectural details

4 community pools!

4-star dining

Boutiques, shops, fun eateries

Beach and Boardwalk by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 This is not your average beach house. Designed by George Israel and just two doors from the sand, Beach and Boardwalk is full of personality, thoughtful details, and an unmistakable “wow” factor that makes it feel more like an experience than just a place to stay. Inside, it’s stylish but relaxed, filled with curated details, warm textures, and spaces that invite you to kick back and pretend you live here year-round. There’s personality around every corner, from the art to the layout. Gulf views and breezy courtyards? Yes, and yes. The whole place feels like your own private corner of Rosemary Beach.

Explore every artistic detail while enjoying modern comforts and effortless beach access, with the town center just a flip-flop stroll away. With Oversee 30A, exceptional service meets unforgettable surroundings. You’ll be taken care of by a local team that’s around every day, with a 24/7 line if anything unexpected comes up. We make luxury feel laid-back. Just like it should. Overview: - Located two homes from the beach - Private beach access - 4 community pools - Covered porches and stunning Gulf views from private balconies - Unique nautical-inspired interiors - Dining table for 6, bar seating for 3 - Fully equipped kitchen w/stainless steel appliances and gas stove - Beach chair and umbrella service (additional fees) - Fitness center (additional fees) - Tennis courts (additional fees) Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: Queen bed, private bath, tub and glass-enclosed shower, private shuttered porch - Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, private bath with shower - Bunk Room: Two twin-over-twin bunks, private bath w/shower (no TV) SECOND FLOOR - Full bath with tub/shower combination THIRD FLOOR - Loft with queen bed, two elevated twin beds, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
